name: Camila Wojciechowski
location: The Shelf — lower district tenements near the old lakeshore, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Camila Wojciechowski is slight and easy to overlook, which is exactly the point. At 36, the augmentation scarring around her temples and jawline tells a story of installation by someone who prioritized function over aesthetics. The chrome is visible — move-by-wire system — full nervous system augmentation, makes the body a weapon  — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Her entry into running was involuntary — a debt to the wrong people, a choice between working it off or losing parts — and the debt is still not fully paid. She works as a sniper out of The Shelf, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

The fixers who work with Camila Wojciechowski describe her as a precision instrument — point her at a problem and get out of the way.

core_fears: Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
core_desires: Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
To protect the people in their district who can't protect themselves
coping_mechanisms: Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Control — micromanages everything within reach to compensate for the chaos everywhere else
Overwork — takes every contract offered because idleness invites thinking
blind_spots: Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
psychology.secret: Liora Sundberg-Boadu is slowly going chrome-sick — rejection symptoms are manageable now but getting worse. Has maybe two years before it becomes visible.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, technical, stripped of ornament. Speaks like a mission briefing.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic, almost musical — the sentence structure has a pattern even when the words are brutal.
verbal_tics: Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
Never uses contractions when lying — 'I did not' instead of 'I didn't'
example_lines: "Patience is the weapon. The rifle is just the delivery system."
"At this distance, the target is already dead. They just don't know it yet."
"One shot, one outcome. Everything else is theater."

story_hooks: A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Liora Sundberg-Boadu's reputation — and a price for silence
Someone is impersonating Liora Sundberg-Boadu on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
A crew member from Liora Sundberg-Boadu's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
narrative_function: Liora Sundberg-Boadu is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When she makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of her stories.
augmentations: Move-by-wire system — full nervous system augmentation, makes the body a weapon platform. Cortical bomb (employer installed, removed by street doc, scar tissue remains)
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.
affiliation: Semi-independent — has standing arrangements with several crews

strengths: photographic memory for faces and layouts
weaknesses: inability to delegate — must control everything personally

decision_rules: Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
habits: Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
breaking_points: Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity
Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap
Learning that a job they completed resulted in mass casualties they weren't told about

physical_description.heritage: Eastern European-dominant ancestry (53.6%) with substantial Hispanic/Latin American (23.0%), South Asian (8.3%), Pacific Islander (8.2%), and Sub-Saharan African (6.9%) admixture. Phenotype reflects this complex global blend: Eastern European bone structure combined with warmth and dimension from Latin American and African heritage, eye shape and placement influenced by South Asian ancestry, and subtle Pacific Islander softness to facial contours. The Ubiquitous Diaspora made flesh — a harmonious, multitonal blend rather than a single dominant appearance, with skin that shifts tonality across different lighting conditions.
physical_description.build: Lean and wiry — muscle density optimized for precision work rather than bulk. Move-by-wire augmentation creates an almost unnaturally efficient frame, no wasted mass.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with natural bronze undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back tight, practical — usually in a braid or ponytail, minimal styling
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with golden undertones — a complex, multitonal complexion where Eastern European, Hispanic/Latin American, South Asian, and Sub-Saharan African ancestries create visible harmonic blending. Olive-warm in daylight, deeper amber in neon. Demonstrates the characteristic depth of heavily mixed heritage without a dominant tonal baseline.
physical_description.complexion: Clean-shaven face with Eastern European-influenced bone structure noticeably softened by Latin American and South Asian features — broader cheekbones than purely Eastern European, slightly fuller lower face from Latin American heritage, almond-shaped eyes with distinct South Asian eye shape influence, subtle eyelid characteristics reflecting South Asian ancestry. Minimal cosmetic care — skin bears the weathering of street life and augmentation stress. Expression neutral by default, eyes do the talking.
distinguishing_marks: Raised chrome-edged surgical scars running vertically along both temples, from augmentation installation, visible when hair is pulled back
Jagged scar tissue along the left jawline and behind the ear — remnant from cortical bomb removal by street doc, crude but functional healing
Fine network of subcutaneous chrome visible under the skin at wrists and forearms where move-by-wire system connects to musculature
Small burn scar on the inside of right forearm — old, from pre-augmentation life, usually hidden by long sleeves
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome-edged surgical scarring at temples and jawline; subdued metallic sheen visible under skin at wrists and forearms indicating move-by-wire neural pathways; movement carries the precise, economical quality of someone whose nervous system has been rewired for lethality
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and controlled — no wasted motion. Stands with weight slightly forward, shoulders relaxed but ready. Eyes track movement constantly. When in motion, each gesture is deliberate and calibrated; the move-by-wire system makes her movements appear slightly too smooth, slightly too perfect, subtly inhuman.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian — dark, durable fabrics that don't show wear or blood. Long sleeves standard to cover augmentation scarring. Worn synth-leather jacket with hidden pockets for maintenance tools and ammunition. Cargo pants with reinforced thigh pockets. Steel-toed boots, scuffed and practical. No ornamentation or chrome jewelry — chrome is functional, not decorative. Between contracts, favors baggy hoodies and neutral colors to become forgettable.

image_prompt: Camila Wojciechowski, lean 164cm female operative, warm medium-brown complexion with golden undertones reflecting mixed Eastern European-Hispanic-South Asian-Pacific Islander-African heritage, almond-shaped gray-green eyes, dark bronze-tinted hair pulled back tight in practical braid, revealing chrome-edged surgical scars at temples. Broad cheekbones and softened Eastern European bone structure. Worn synth-leather jacket, long sleeves covering subcutaneous chrome at forearms, cargo pants, scuffed steel-toed boots. Standing in neon-lit GLMZ 2200s Great Lakes zone, shoulders relaxed but ready, weight forward, neutral expression, eyes tracking. Movement unnaturally smooth from move-by-wire augmentation. Cold blue and amber neon lighting casting sharp shadows on scarred face. Utilitarian, forgettable, lethal. GLMZ street operative aesthetic. --ar 2:3 --v 6
